intro: Options for review. Nothing here has been implemented. Choose the paths to take, then the owner of each area will make the change.

suggestions.suggestion: Pick the stay length first (3 nights Feb 15-18 vs 7 nights Feb 15-22 vs another 7-night window).
suggestions.why: Every price and availability question depends on it (Q1).

suggestions.suggestion: Capture dated official rate snapshots for the chosen dates at each hotel's booking engine (2 adults, refundable and non-refundable, with taxes and fees), and store the URL and time with each.
suggestions.why: Replaces the blank price fields with verifiable values (Q2).

suggestions.suggestion: Set up a weekly rate log in a spreadsheet, not an automated scraper. Booking-site terms often prohibit scraping.
suggestions.why: Builds the price history needed to answer 'cheapest time to book' (Q3).

suggestions.suggestion: Verify each Michelin status on guide.michelin.com by hand, and add a 'last checked' date column.
suggestions.why: The Michelin site could not be reached from this environment (Q7).

suggestions.suggestion: Run the official RTC Trip Planner for each hotel-to-restaurant pair at the planned time and record the minutes.
suggestions.why: Replaces the unverified 'within 1 hour' ranking with real travel times (Q6).

suggestions.suggestion: Decide whether to rent a car. A car changes which restaurants and activities fit in one hour.
suggestions.why: Affects Red Rock, Valley of Fire and off-Strip dining (Q10).

suggestions.suggestion: Add a weighted decision matrix (price, travel time, Michelin count, amenities, private bathroom). You choose the weights.
suggestions.why: Turns the ranking into a transparent choice.

suggestions.suggestion: Start with the bookable starred venues (Joël Robuchon, L'Atelier, é, Guy Savoy) and check the 30-60 day and 3-month booking windows against the Feb 2027 dates.
suggestions.why: Starred tables are the hardest to get (Q7-Q8).

suggestions.suggestion: Add a 'Last verified' date and source link column to every table, and show blank fields as 'UNVERIFIED' in a single style.
suggestions.why: Makes the verification status visible at a glance.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a link checker to the build so the site fails when an internal link breaks.
Decide on one publishing method (GitHub Actions or branch-based Pages) and update the README to match.
suggestions.why: The README and the Pages workflow describe different methods (see repo review).

suggestions.suggestion: Exclude COORDINATION.md and internal research notes from the published artifact, or keep them and say so.
suggestions.why: pages.yml uploads the whole repository root, so internal files are public.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a LICENSE and a .gitignore, and review the personal email in the initial commit metadata.
Merge the two overlapping site builds (root dashboard and the research sub-site) into one source of truth.
suggestions.why: Two copies of the data could drift apart.
